tasks: place the square building blocks in the center with left hand and put the cylindrical building blocks on top with right hand.

generation_prompt: The robot's left hand, on the left side of the view, grips the green cube between its thumb and fingers, lifts it, carries it toward the table center, sets it down and releases it. The robot's right hand then closes its fingers around the green cylinder, lifts it, carries it over the cube, lowers it onto the cube's top face and releases it, leaving the cylinder resting on top of the cube. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
data_quality_gate.exception_reason: Visual-review exception (2026-10-15): edges of the hands and blocks are judged acceptable; the low score is driven mostly by the large untextured table.
